speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand the severity of your condition, have you experienced any high fevers or chills recently? Also, how long have these symptoms been persisting?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pneumonia. Given your recent influenza diagnosis, failure to treat, and symptoms of productive cough with purulent sputum and shortness of breath, you likely have a secondary bacterial pneumonia. Please see a medical professional immediately for a chest X-ray and antibiotics.
